name: @office/intelligence-relationships
description: Office cross-domain relationship engine (OFF-013): the canonical affects/depends-on/evidenced-by/impacts/derives-from relationship index over the enterprise graph — a deterministic, rebuildable read PROJECTION derived from the landed domain packages' event envelopes (never a second source of truth, freeze A2/A7), with traversal queries that enforce authorization at traversal time (deny-by-default, structural A12 isolation — cross-tenant/cross-project nodes are invisible, no existence oracle) and causal-chain queries that reconstruct the command/event chain that produced each relationship from the edges' event-id provenance. Depends only on @office/contracts, @office/domain-kernel, @office/authz, and @office/events (the ledger READ surface + deterministic ledger event id derivation — this package never writes the ledger).
